## Introduction

Semi-quantitation was done in ImageJ 1.54g according to this protocol: https://www.yorku.ca/yisheng/Internal/Protocols/ImageJ.pdf

## Analysis

### Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Read files

```{r}
folder <- "intensities"

wb_intensities <- paste0(folder, "/", list.files(folder)) |>
  purrr::map(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Invert values

```{r}
wb_intensities <- wb_intensities |>
  purrr::map(mutate, Inverted_Background = 255 - Background) |>
  purrr::map(mutate, Inverted_Band = 255 - Band)
```

### Subtract background

```{r}
wb_intensities <- wb_intensities |>
  purrr::map(mutate, Background_corrected = Inverted_Band - Inverted_Background)
```

### Normalize to Hsp90 and to mean

```{r}
wb_intensities <- wb_intensities |>
  purrr::map(select, -Band, -Background, -Inverted_Band, -Inverted_Background)

intensities_cyp <- wb_intensities[[1]] |>
  rename(Intensity_CYP = Background_corrected)

intensities <- wb_intensities[[2]] |>
  rename(Intensity_Hsp = Background_corrected) |>
  right_join(intensities_cyp, by = join_by(Line, Passage, Replicate)) |>
  mutate(Normalized = Intensity_CYP / Intensity_Hsp) |>
  group_by(Replicate) |>
  mutate(Mean = mean(Normalized)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Normalized = Normalized / Mean) |>
  mutate(Line = case_when(Line == "WT" ~ "wt",
                          Line == "CYP2E1"  ~ "2E1",
                          .default = Line)) |>
  mutate(Line = paste0("Hep-G2-", Line)) |>
  mutate(`Cell line` = Line)
```


### Plot

```{r}
intensities_mean <- intensities |>
  group_by(`Cell line`, Passage) |>
  summarise(Normalized = mean(Normalized)) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(intensities_mean, aes(Passage, Normalized, colour = `Cell line`)) +
  geom_point(shape = 4, size = 3) +
  ylab("Relative CYP2E1 Intensity / a.u.") +
  xlab("Passage Number") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data = intensities, aes(Passage, Normalized, colour = `Cell line`), alpha = 0.3, size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("plots/wb_plot.svg", width = 6, height = 3.3)
```
